ChallengeEnd.description: Rules 0.8.1: a duel over, applied at the resolve (`round.outcome.public.duels[]`).

deed.description: One line: the duel mind's, else the rules'.

log.description: The blows this final resolve was handed (earlier ones came live and in challenge.open).

panels.description: Rules 0.8.2: the rest of its panels, through the outro (`starts_at_ms` may lie ahead: play them out).

pos.description: `at` at full precision (outcome numbers are rounded to 2 decimals except `pos`).

provisional.description: State schema 12, live only: shown at once by the duel action that closed the duel (a knockout's outro, or the first action stamped past the deadline): who won and the healths, `deed` empty, `log` empty. The next resolve applies it and sends the full `challenge.end` for the same `duel_id`.

ChallengeLock.description: Rules 0.8.1: `phase.event.public` when a challenge is accepted (or `round.started.public.challenges[]` for the AI's): both portraits lock in.

a.description: Rules 0.8.1: one duellist at the lock.

health.description: Health at the lock (both are shown: the duel's health bars).

skin.description: Its mannequin's skin. From the name: FNV-1a 32 of the name's UTF-8 bytes with ASCII A-Z lower-cased, mod 5 in this order; unless it holds a thing a god granted (dragonscale) or a thing of gold (gold). Absent from servers before this field: compute it from the name.

also.description: Rules 0.8.2: the duel's scene and panel 0, made with the lock (state schema 12: then the first typing script of each AI fighter). Handle each entry as its own event.

b.description: Rules 0.8.1: one duellist at the lock.

health.description: Health at the lock (both are shown: the duel's health bars).

skin.description: Its mannequin's skin. From the name: FNV-1a 32 of the name's UTF-8 bytes with ASCII A-Z lower-cased, mod 5 in this order; unless it holds a thing a god granted (dragonscale) or a thing of gold (gold). Absent from servers before this field: compute it from the name.

by_seat.description: The challenger's seat; null for the AI.

deadline_ms.description: Epoch ms: lines after it are refused (null for the AI's challenges).

duel_id.description: duel:s<seq>:<a>:<b> (a player's challenge: its action's seq) or duel:<beat>:<a>:<b> (the AI's)

ends_beat.description: The last beat whose resolve may still carry it (the world keeps beating meanwhile).

focus.description: Centre the camera and spin the globe here.

freeze.description: The world hold the duel requests (supported once the engine has holds).

leap.description: The AI challenger summoned itself next to its rival first (applied at the resolve).

world.description: beating until the engine offers a hold window.

DuelBlow.description: Rules 0.8.1: `phase.event.public` for each duel line, at once (also in the resolve's challenge.open / challenge.end log).

ai.description: State schema 12: an AI fighter's typed line (its typing script's text), entered at `at_ms` = the script's `ends_at_ms`. It has no `seq`.

also.description: Live event only: what this line's stamp made due: panels (rules 0.8.2), and in state schema 12 the AI lines entered before it (`duel.blow`, `ai: true`), the typing scripts of the windows opened, and a provisional `challenge.end` when it closed the duel. Handle each as its own event.

anim.description: Rules 0.8.1: animation cues for the figures (deterministic, from the rules).

auto.description: An automatic blow (an AI counter or a duel nobody typed in).

choreo.description: Rules 0.8.1: the formal model's choreography of one strike (DM_RULEBOOK 21.4).

contacts.description: Every contact: who hits, with which limb, which body part of the other, when (empty when nothing lands).

handicap.description: State schema 12: an AI's typed line against a human (minus `duel_ai_handicap`).

move.description: State schema 12: what the line's words picked (docs/CLIENT_API.md "Words to moves"): the clip its figure plays for this strike.

setup.description: The clips of the earlier move words of the line, played first (at most two).

word.description: The move word read (as the table has it: `attack` for `attck`); null: none, the class's own clip.

self_damage.description: A penalty's cost to its author.

tags.description: What the wit saw: verb, combo, body, item, terrain, story, repeat, echo, short, spam, empty, rate_limit.

window.description: State schema 12 (with `ai`): the panel whose input window the line was typed in.

DuelPanel.description: Rules 0.8.2: `duel.panel`, one comic panel of a duel: the presentation of the blows of one input window (they are decided by the 0.8.1 rules; a panel decides nothing). Sent in `also[]` of the action that made it due, as the event of a `duel_tick`, in `challenge.open` / `challenge.end`, and all of them in `present.duels[].panels`.

at.description: A stage hex [q, r]: x = 1.732 (q + r/2), z = 1.5 r metres.

auto.description: An automatic counter of its is staged here.

default.description: It did nothing in the window: the rules default it plays.

line.description: The last line it typed in the window this panel stages (null: none).

line_masked_len.description: That line's length in characters (0: none).

lines.description: Lines it typed in the window.

move_class.description: Its last move's class (strike, heavy, guard, parry, feint, evade, close, retreat, grapple, throw, invoke, command, taunt).

segs.description: Clip segments in order; their `ms` sum to `play_ms`.

on.description: wallrun, wallkick, mantle: the object id.

to.description: A stage hex [q, r]: x = 1.732 (q + r/2), z = 1.5 r metres.

also.description: Live event only: further panels made due by the same action (state schema 12: also the AI lines it entered, the typing scripts of the windows opened, and a provisional `challenge.end` after the outro).

ko.description: Outro only: the side knocked out.

play_ms.description: 2400..3600; in state schema 12, a panel that opens a window an AI types in plays as long as its line needs (up to about 6000).

starts_at_ms.description: Server epoch ms: the previous panel's end.

DuelScene.description: Rules 0.8.2: `duel.scene`, the duel's stage dressing in the duel lab's scene shape (in the lock's `also[]`, and in `present.duels[].scene`). `source: rules` is the deterministic fallback; an authored scene will use the same shape.

a_start.description: A stage hex [q, r]: x = 1.732 (q + r/2), z = 1.5 r metres.

b_start.description: A stage hex [q, r]: x = 1.732 (q + r/2), z = 1.5 r metres.

biome.description: harbour | forest | desert | hills | town | wild

affords.description: The paths that may name it.

size.description: box [w,h,d]; cylinder, cone [r,h]; the others [r]. Metres.

DuelTypingScript.description: State schema 12: `duel.typing_script`, the line an AI fighter types in one input window, to be played back by every client as masked live typing (the server sends no frames). Character k (1-based) appears at `starts_at_ms + k * key_ms + the ms of every pause with after < k`; at `ends_at_ms` it presses Enter and the line is a `duel.blow` (`ai: true`). Sent in `also[]` after the panel that opens the window (and after the lock), on that panel as `a|b.typing_script`, and while it is being typed in `present.duels[].typing_scripts`.

cps.description: Characters a second (seeded per demigod and match).

pauses.description: 0 to 2 pauses between words, in order.

starts_at_ms.description: Server epoch ms: it starts typing (after the window opens).

text.description: The whole line. Public by design: mask it as you mask live typing.

window.description: The panel (`n`) whose input window it is typed in.

LonLat.description: [longitude, latitude] in degrees (WGS84). Note the order: longitude first.

Present.description: State schema 8 (exact resume): the present moment, in every public view (so in every match.snapshot) and in `game.present`. See docs/TIME_TRAVEL.md.

events.description: The public events of the instant actions since the last resolve, in arrival order.

items.description: A phase.event.public payload (cast streak, summoning, god_power, challenge.lock, duel.blow) with its `seq`, `received_at_ms` and `beat`.

live.description: This is the match's live state (false: a past state, shown as it was, or a fork before its first Start).

mark.description: The newest instant action the state itself contains, and its clocks.

paused_since_ms.description: The room stands still since then (nobody connected, or restored and not started).

server_time_ms.description: The server's clock when this view was built.

PresentDuel.description: State schema 8: one open duel in full, as it stands now (`present.duels[]`): enough to redraw it and seek to the exact offset.

blows.description: Every blow so far, in order, as it was shown: the state's, then the ones since the last resolve. Each has `at_ms` and `seq` (automatic blows of an unattended duel have none).

clock.description: Its clock when the view was built (frozen at `present.paused_since_ms` while the room stands still).

elapsed_ms.description: Duel time elapsed: the offset to seek to.

opened.description: A resolve has applied its lock.

over.description: Knocked out or past its deadline: the next resolve ends it.

panels.description: Rules 0.8.2: every panel so far, in order.

pauses.description: [from_ms, to_ms] spans its clock stood still.

set.description: The defence each side has set and not used.

started_ms.description: The lock's server stamp (null: an AI's challenge in a state without the beat's clock).

typing.description: Live typing: each side's unsent line as its last `duel.typing` left it (never the characters).

at_ms.description: The server stamp of that message; null: none since this server process started.

len.description: Characters typed and not sent (0: nothing, or the line was sent).

at_ms.description: The server stamp of that message; null: none since this server process started.

len.description: Characters typed and not sent (0: nothing, or the line was sent).

typing_scripts.description: State schema 12 (a duel whose AI types): the lines its AI fighters are typing right now. Seek each to `present.server_time_ms`.

Ref.description: A pointer to any row of the world: dg demigod, ch character, cl cluster, gr group, gd god, pl place, it item, ag agent, lg ledger row, ce cell, mb mob. Stable for the whole match.

description: `game.present` (state schema 8): the present moment, the same object as match.snapshot.public_state.present; null in older states.
title: game.present

x-args.description: Over HTTP every arg is a query-string parameter (numbers as numeric strings). Unknown args are ignored.

x-description: Exact resume (state schema 8): the present moment: the server's clock, the public events of the instant actions since the last resolve (casts, summonings, challenge.lock, duel.blow) and every open duel in full (fighters, hp, range, initiative, stances, every blow so far with its choreography and stamps, deadline and clock). The same object as match.snapshot.public_state.present. Loads the whole state: ask it when you (re)connect, don't poll it. null in older states.
